name: Activity — Load Feed (Data Tables)
description: UI-importable hydrate: load one task CAS row + handoff traces into Activity feed payload. Bind both Data Tables in UI. Webhook path mas-activity-load-feed.

parameters.content:
## Activity — Load Feed
1. Bind **Load task row** → `engineering_orchestrator_tasks_v1`.
2. Bind **Load trace rows** → `mas_trace_events_v1`.
3. Activate webhook. Body: `{ "task_id": "eng_…" }`.
4. Activity: `ACTIVITY_FEED_URL=http://<n8n>/webhook/mas-activity-load-feed`.

Returns status/version/human_gate + handoff events for `/v1/hydrate`.
